reviews.concise_rationale: Readable top-of-pipeline view with three source streams feeding the unified BPE tokenizer and pretrained GPT-2 model. The labels, arrows, and objects are coherent for the DNA, protein, and English pretraining routes.

The crop clearly shows the multimodal fusion path from protein interactions and biological processes into a knowledge graph and then into the foundation model/GCN stack. It is coherent for the knowledge-graph route.

The crop shows the feature-extraction side of Shusi with amino-acid sequences and functional descriptions encoded through an LLM into protein embeddings before graph construction. That supports both embedding routes.
This is a clean, readable source-to-model path from tissue patch to cell sentences to a spatial sentence feeding the LLM. The route is directly supported by the visible labels and arrows.
